items.snippet: K-pop giant Hybe reported record third-quarter revenue and operating profit Tuesday, propelled by BTS' ongoing world tour, putting it on track to become the first K-pop agency to s...
items.description: K-pop giant Hybe reported record third-quarter revenue and operating profit Tuesday, propelled by BTS' ongoing world tour, putting it on track to become the first K-pop agency to surpass 4 trillion won ($2.98 billion) in annual revenue. According to its regulatory filing, the company's preliminary revenue for the July–September period jumped 109.8 percent year-on-year to 1.53 trillion won on a consolidated basis. items.description: Two shows from K-pop supergroup BTS' upcoming tour in Taiwan and Jakarta will be livestreamed at movie theaters in more than 80 countries and regions, the group's agency said Tuesday. items.title: BTS' J-Hope clocks 100m views with ‘Mona Lisa’ music video
items.snippet: J-Hope of BTS hit the 100 million threshold on YouTube with the music video for his solo single, “Mona Lisa,” on Saturday, according to label Big Hit Music. It is his fourth music...
items.description: J-Hope of BTS hit the 100 million threshold on YouTube with the music video for his solo single, “Mona Lisa,” on Saturday, according to label Big Hit Music. It is his fourth music video to achieve the feat, after “Daydream,” “Chicken Noodle Soup,” and “Killin’ It Girl.” “Mona Lisa” was released in March 2025, and the upbeat funky tune based on hip-hop and R&B entered Billboard’s Hot 100 at No. 65 and the UK Official Singles Top 100 at No. 56. It entered Spotify’s Weekly Top Songs Global at No. 2
